context: Request: which fund and asset-management matters include a management-fee offset or waiver, with the relevant fund documents, for drafting a new fund's fee provisions. Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent, side-letter compliance memo), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate Fund V, LPA/PPM drafts), 1023-00001 (Ironside co-invest, executed LP agreement) and 1027-00002 (Pellegrino co-invest, execution-version co-invest LPA) as matters and proof documents, plus precision; 1023-00003, 1004-00002, 1002-00003, 1026-00001, 1026-00002 and 1002-00005 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a capped find of the top directory levels; the declared label fits the work.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python path search for request and document words (99 matters) and a brace glob that returns nothing. The review flags the truncated output and the failed glob.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: broader grouped path search (163 matters) saved to a file; a stage_start for a scan is refused because this stage is still open.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script times out; a rerun over nine named matters also times out, with a mid-stage protocol check on the narrowed call.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of eight candidate matters. The review flags a hand-picked subset and names unlisted matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Twelve parallel reads of agreements, side letters, memos and an offering document from six candidate matters; the stage_start note pointed to screening. The review flags the narrow candidate set and drafts reported as confirmed, naming a third-draft side letter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: bounded store-wide extraction limited by a file-name prefilter. The review flags the prefilter and claimed hits not visible in the output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: a scan without the prefilter times out with no output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Eleven reads of documents from seven matters surfaced by the scan; the stage_start note again pointed to screening. The review (yes) asks to label executed versus draft, to check one matter before including it and to treat another as non-qualifying.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a table of qualifying matters with status labels, documents and exclusions. The review says drafts, term-sheet-only and sibling matters belong only in the exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check fails on the relative path and is rerun on the output file; two edits soften one matter's status.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads seven cited sources; no edits. The review says to leave the matter set unchanged.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The reading review at [54] named a third-draft side letter reported as confirmed, the review at [82] asked to check or drop two matters, and the write review at [88] said drafts belong only in the exclusions; the agent kept them as labelled precedents.
first_error.why: The answer presents five further matters (draft side letters, a first-draft agreement, a tax-response narrative) as qualifying precedents, relying on status labels instead of leaving them out (evidence seen at [40]-[80]).

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

first_error.why: The range scan wrote its hits to a file that the agent viewed only through capped, phrase-filtered greps, so the executed partnership agreement of a co-invest matter it later included never appeared in any result, and the answer cites only that matter's side letter.

runs.failure_point: It listed the files of a co-invest matter, including its execution-version agreement, but never read them and left the matter out of the answer, while including draft and lapsed-negotiation matters.

first_error.critic_note: Reviews flagged about 60 surfaced matters never listed, but none noted that a listed matter was never read or left out of the answer.
first_error.why: The answer omits a matter whose file list, with an execution-version co-invest agreement, it printed at [43]-[45]; it never read any of that matter's files and gave no reason for leaving it out.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [81] named one included side letter as undated and possibly a draft, and the write review at [87] asked to confirm no matter was a draft or term sheet; the set stayed unchanged.
other_errors.why: The answer presents two matters with draft or lapsed side-letter negotiations as qualifying and a third as a near match (evidence seen at [56]-[79]).

divergence: All three runs failed. Every run found two or three of the qualifying matters and wrote draft or lapsed-negotiation matters as qualifying precedents at the write stage, against reviews that flagged drafts (T0 and T2 specifically, T1 generically). T1 and T2 also left out one co-invest matter: T1 never opened it although its path search and scan surfaced it (screening stage), T2 listed its files but never read them (write stage). T1 additionally cited a side letter instead of a co-invest vehicle's partnership agreement, which never appeared in its capped scan views.
